name: Trailing Only with Close All Button v2.1
summary: This EA is a trailing stop management utility that applies trailing stop logic to existing open positions without opening new trades itself. It also provides a 'Close All' button on the chart for one-click liquidation of all open positions. The tool is designed for semi-automated trade management rather than autonomous trading.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个移动止损管理工具，对已有的持仓应用移动止损逻辑，但本身不开仓交易。它还在图表上提供一个'全部平仓'按钮，可以一键平掉所有持仓。该工具用于半自动化的交易管理，而非自主交易。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个持仓管理工具。它的核心功能是对现有持仓应用移动止损（Trailing Stop），当价格朝有利方向移动时，自动将止损位跟进以锁定浮盈。入场条件方面，该EA不自行开仓，仅管理由交易者手动或其他EA开设的仓位。出场条件方面，当止损被触发时平仓，或通过'Close All'按钮一键全部平仓。仓位管理方面，该工具不涉及开仓手数计算，仅调整已持仓的止损水平。资金管理方面，移动止损功能帮助锁定盈利、控制回撤，但止损参数需要交易者合理设置。整体而言，这是一个辅助性工具，依赖交易者自身的判断来开仓，EA仅负责盈利保护和紧急平仓功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but a position management utility. Its core function is applying a trailing stop to existing open positions, automatically moving the stop-loss level in the favorable direction to lock in floating profits as price advances. For entry conditions, the EA does not open trades itself; it only manages positions opened manually by the trader or by other EAs. For exit conditions, positions close when the trailing stop is hit, or the trader can use the 'Close All' button to liquidate all positions instantly. Position sizing is not handled by this tool, as it only adjusts stop-loss levels on existing positions. Money management is supported indirectly through the trailing stop mechanism, which helps lock in profits and control drawdown, though the trailing distance parameter must be set judiciously by the trader. Overall, this is an assistive tool that depends on the trader's own judgment for entries, while the EA handles profit protection and emergency closure.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，定义止损跟进的距离

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损步长，每次调整止损的最小移动距离
parameters.description_en: Minimum trailing stop adjustment step in points

parameters.name: CloseAllButton
parameters.description: 是否在图表上显示全部平仓按钮
parameters.description_en: Whether to display close-all button on chart

pros: 移动止损功能帮助自动锁定浮盈，减少人工盯盘压力
一键全部平仓按钮提供紧急退出能力，在剧烈行情中快速止损
作为纯管理工具不自行开仓，不会产生非预期持仓风险
可与其他交易EA或手动策略配合使用，灵活性强
pros_en: Trailing stop function automatically locks in floating profits, reducing the need for constant manual monitoring
The Close All button provides emergency exit capability for rapid liquidation during volatile market conditions
As a pure management tool that does not open its own positions, it avoids unintended exposure risk
Compatible with other trading EAs or manual strategies, offering high flexibility
cons: 作为工具不提供入场信号，完全依赖交易者自身的开仓判断
移动止损参数设置不当可能导致过早被扫止损或止盈空间不足
缺少对多品种、多策略持仓的差异化移动止损管理
未提供止损调整的可视化反馈或日志记录功能
cons_en: As a utility it provides no entry signals, fully depending on the trader's own judgment to open positions
Improper trailing stop parameter settings may lead to premature stop-outs or insufficient profit room
Lacks differentiated trailing stop management for positions across multiple symbols or strategies
Does not provide visual feedback or logging for stop-loss adjustments
improvements: 增加按品种或魔术号分别设置移动止损参数的功能，支持多策略并行管理
添加移动止损调整的可视化线条和操作日志，提升透明度和可追溯性
improvements_en: Add per-symbol or per-magic-number trailing stop configuration to support parallel management of multiple strategies
Add visual lines on chart and operation logs for trailing stop adjustments to improve transparency and traceability

risk_points: 移动止损参数设置过小可能在市场噪音中被频繁触发止损
全部平仓按钮无二次确认机制，存在误操作风险
risk_points_en: Overly tight trailing stop parameters may cause frequent premature stop-outs from market noise
The Close All button lacks a confirmation dialog, posing a risk of accidental execution
